sourceTitle: Memoir of Father Vincent de Paul; religious of La Trappe
description: "Memoir of Father Vincent de Paul; religious of La Trappe" by Father Vincent de Paul is a historical biography written in the early 19th century. The book details the life and missionary work of Father Vincent, who was a member of the Trappist Order, particularly focusing on his time in America from 1812 to 1823.
